proposedHeads.description: ceil(charge / resolvedRate), further trimmed when a high observed idle share exceeds IDLE_SHARE_TRIM_THRESHOLD (see trimReason). Not committed.

resolvedRate.description: The rate actually used to compute proposedHeads, in units per head per hour -- either the caller-supplied plannedRate, or a measured rate fed back from labor-performance (its mean seconds per task converted to a per-head hourly rate: 3600 / meanActualSeconds). 0 when neither was available (proposedHeads is then also 0).

rateSource.description: Where resolvedRate came from: "caller" (a supplied plannedRate, or no rate was available at all) or "measured" (fed back from labor-performance). Lets a human see why proposedHeads came back 0 (no rate from either source) rather than guessing.

trimReason.description: Non-empty only when a high observed idle share (idleness-as-staffing-signal) trimmed proposedHeads -- explains the observed share, the threshold, and the before/after head counts, so the trim is auditable. Omitted (or empty) when no trim was applied, including when no idle-share signal is available at all (fail-open).
trimReason.example: observed idle share 50.0% for path "pack" exceeds the 30.0% trim threshold; heads trimmed from 10 to 5
